params:

  scenario: "Registration_Flow"
  baseline: "run_001"
  runs: !r c("run_001", "run_002")
  label_filter: ""
  excluded_labels: !r character(0)
  db_path: "Data/Performance_Vault.db"
  tool: "jmeter"
  report_id: "performance"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)

library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(stringr)

```

```{r connection, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Debug: Output runtime parameters
# cat(sprintf("\n>>> [DEBUG] Vault Path: '%s'\n", params$db_path))
# cat(sprintf(">>> [DEBUG] Target Tool: '%s'\n", params$tool))
# cat(sprintf(">>> [DEBUG] Filter Parameter: '%s'\n", params$label_filter))

# Establish connection to DuckDB
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(shared_home = FALSE), dbdir = params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)

# Determine correct table name based on engine selection
target_table <- paste0("performance_history_", params$tool)

# Validate that the target table exists in the database
if (!target_table %in% dbListTables(con)) {
  dbDisconnect(con)
  stop(paste0("Error: Table '", target_table, "' does not exist in vault."))
}

# ── Step 1: Resolve Run Identifiers (run_id vs sequence_num) ──
all_identifiers <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf(
  "SELECT DISTINCT run_id, sequence_num FROM %s", target_table
))

resolved_run_ids <- sapply(params$runs, function(r) {
  match_by_run_id <- all_identifiers$run_id[all_identifiers$run_id == r]
  if (length(match_by_run_id) > 0) return(match_by_run_id[1])

  match_by_seq <- all_identifiers$run_id[as.character(all_identifiers$sequence_num) == as.character(r)]
  if (length(match_by_seq) > 0) return(match_by_seq[1])

  return(NA_character_)
})

missing_runs <- params$runs[is.na(resolved_run_ids)]
if (length(missing_runs) > 0) {
  dbDisconnect(con)
  stop(paste0("Error: Run(s) not found in vault: ", paste(missing_runs, collapse = ", ")))
}

resolved_run_ids <- unname(resolved_run_ids)
formatted_run_ids <- paste0("'", gsub("'", "''", resolved_run_ids), "'", collapse = ", ")

# ── Step 2: Tool-Aware Schema Projections ──
bytes_col         <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") "bytes" else "0 AS bytes"
response_code_col <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") "responseCode" else "'0' AS responseCode"
response_msg_col <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") "responseMessage" else "'0' AS responseMessage"

# ── Step 3: Dynamic Multi-Keyword SQL Filter Construction ──
sql_filter_clause <- ""

if (!is.null(params$label_filter) &&
    nzchar(trimws(params$label_filter)) &&
    toupper(trimws(params$label_filter)) != "NONE") {

  # Split on commas, strip surrounding whitespace, and remove empty entries
  raw_tokens <- unlist(strsplit(params$label_filter, ","))
  cleaned_tokens <- trimws(raw_tokens)
  cleaned_tokens <- cleaned_tokens[nzchar(cleaned_tokens)]

  if (length(cleaned_tokens) > 0) {
    # Escape single quotes for SQL safety
    escaped_tokens <- gsub("'", "''", cleaned_tokens)

    # Generate a LIKE condition for each keyword
    token_clauses <- sprintf("label LIKE '%%%s%%'", escaped_tokens)

    # Join with OR logic and wrap in parentheses
    sql_filter_clause <- paste0(" AND (", paste(token_clauses, collapse = " OR "), ")")

    message(sprintf(">>> [SQL FILTER] Applying DuckDB Predicate: %s", sql_filter_clause))
  }
}

# ── Step 4: Assemble Optimized Columnar Query ──
query <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    sequence_num,
    run_id,
    project_name,
    test_name,
    app_name,
    csv_filename,
    thread_group,
    timestamp,
    elapsed,
    label,
    success,
    %s,
    %s,
    %s,
    user_index
  FROM %s
  WHERE run_id IN (%s)%s
  ORDER BY timestamp ASC
", bytes_col, response_code_col, response_msg_col, target_table, formatted_run_ids, sql_filter_clause)

# Execute query and extract dataset
raw_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query)
dbDisconnect(con)

effective_exclusions <- params$excluded_labels

if (!is.null(params$label_filter) &&
    nzchar(trimws(params$label_filter))) {

  requested_labels <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(params$label_filter, ",")))

  effective_exclusions <- setdiff(
    effective_exclusions,
    requested_labels
  )
}

raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(!label %in% effective_exclusions)

# ── Step 5: Post-Extraction Dataset Validation ──
if (nrow(raw_data) == 0) {
  stop(paste0(
    "Error: No transactions matched query criteria.\n",
    "  Runs: ", paste(resolved_run_ids, collapse = ", "), "\n",
    "  Filter: '", params$label_filter, "'"
  ))
}

if (!"label" %in% colnames(raw_data)) {
  stop("Column 'label' is missing from retrieved dataset. Verify schema mapping.")
}
```

```{r data_preparation, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE, echo = F, warning = F, message = F}
# Always group by label
group_col <- "label"

# executionGroup = thread_group for both tools
raw_data <- raw_data %>% mutate(executionGroup = thread_group)

# Compute summary metrics
summary_stats <- raw_data %>%
  rename(current_group = !!sym(group_col)) %>%
  mutate(
    success_clean = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))),
    success = success_clean %in% c("true", "yes", "1") | success == TRUE
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name, run_id, thread_group, current_group) %>%
  summarise(
    `min(ms)`     = round(min(elapsed, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    `avg(ms)`     = round(mean(elapsed, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    `p90(ms)`     = round(quantile(elapsed, 0.90, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    `p95(ms)`     = round(quantile(elapsed, 0.95, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    `max(ms)`     = round(max(elapsed, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    totalCount = n(),
    passCount  = sum(success, na.rm=TRUE),
    failCount  = sum(!success, na.rm=TRUE),
    recievedBytes = format(round(mean(bytes, na.rm=TRUE), 0), big.mark=","),
    .groups='drop'
  )

# Pivot for side‑by‑side comparison
comparison <- summary_stats %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(thread_group, current_group),
    names_from  = run_id,
    values_from = c(`min(ms)`, `avg(ms)`, `p90(ms)`, `p95(ms)`,
                    `max(ms)`, totalCount, passCount, failCount, recievedBytes),
    names_sep   = "\r\n"
  ) %>%
  rename(!!sym(group_col) := current_group)

# Slowest transactions (top 1000 per run)
prepped_logs <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id, app_name) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = elapsed, n = 1000, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Application           = app_name,
    `Response time (ms)`  = as.numeric(elapsed),
    timestamp             = sub("Z$", "", as.character(timestamp)),
    success               = ifelse(
      tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in% c("true", "yes", "1"),
      "TRUE",
      "FALSE"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Application, run_id, thread_group, label, `Response time (ms)`, timestamp, success) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Response time (ms)`))

unique_apps_vector <- sort(unique(prepped_logs$app_name))
unique_runs_vector <- sort(unique(prepped_logs$run_id), decreasing = TRUE)
most_recent_run    <- unique_runs_vector[1]

# Error logs
prepped_error_logs <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in% c("false", "no", "0")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Application          = app_name,
    `Response time (ms)` = as.numeric(elapsed),
    timestamp            = sub("Z$", "", as.character(timestamp)),
    `Response Code`      = if (params$tool == "jmeter") as.character(responseCode) else "N/A"
  ) %>%
  select(Application, run_id, thread_group, label, `Response time (ms)`, `Response Code`, timestamp) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Response time (ms)`))

# Run selector vectors
unique_runs_vector <- sort(unique(prepped_logs$run_id), decreasing=TRUE)
most_recent_run    <- unique_runs_vector[1]

# Build a structured summary object to pass to AI
ai_summary_data <- list(
  runs = lapply(resolved_run_ids, function(r) {
    run_rows <- raw_data %>% filter(run_id == r)
    list(
      run_id        = r,
      sequence_num  = first(run_rows$sequence_num),
      test_name     = unique(run_rows$test_name)[1],
      app_name      = unique(run_rows$app_name)[1],
      start_time    = format(min(run_rows$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      end_time      = format(max(run_rows$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      duration_mins = round(as.numeric(difftime(
        max(run_rows$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(run_rows$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        units = "mins"
      )), 0),
      total_users   = n_distinct(run_rows$user_index, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_tx      = nrow(run_rows),
      throughput    = round(
        sum(
          tolower(trimws(as.character(run_rows$success))) %in%
          c("true", "yes", "1"),
          na.rm = TRUE
          ) / as.numeric(difftime(
            max(run_rows$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
            min(run_rows$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
            units = "secs"
      )), 2),
      passed        = sum(tolower(trimws(as.character(run_rows$success))) %in% c("true", "yes")),
      failed        = sum(tolower(trimws(as.character(run_rows$success))) %in% c("false", "no")),
      error_rate    = round(
        sum(tolower(trimws(as.character(run_rows$success))) %in% c("false", "no")) /
        nrow(run_rows) * 100, 2
      )
    )
  })
)

# ============================================================
# SLA EVALUATION — applied globally across all selected runs
# ============================================================
sla_results <- list()  # named list keyed by run_id, empty if no SLA defined

sla_file_path <- params_cfg$sla_file_path

if (!is.null(sla_file_path) && nzchar(trimws(sla_file_path)) && file.exists(here::here(sla_file_path))) {

  sla_config <- yaml::read_yaml(here::here(sla_file_path))
  sla_rules  <- sla_config$sla_rules

  evaluate_sla_rule <- function(actual_value, operator, threshold) {
    switch(
      operator,
      "<="  = actual_value <= threshold,
      ">="  = actual_value >= threshold,
      "<"   = actual_value <  threshold,
      ">"   = actual_value >  threshold,
      "=="  = actual_value == threshold,
      NA
    )
  }

  # ── Compute the 3 metrics directly per run_id from raw_data ──
  sla_metrics_per_run <- raw_data %>%
    mutate(
      is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in% c("true", "yes")
    ) %>%
    group_by(run_id) %>%
    summarise(
      total_users = n_distinct(user_index, na.rm = TRUE),
      error_rate  = round((sum(!is_pass, na.rm = TRUE) / n()) * 100, 2),
      throughput  = round(sum(is_pass, na.rm = TRUE) / as.numeric(difftime(
        max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE), min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE), units = "secs"
      )), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ── Evaluate each rule per run_id ──
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sla_metrics_per_run))) {
    run_row <- sla_metrics_per_run[i, ]
    rid     <- run_row$run_id

    rule_outcomes <- lapply(sla_rules, function(rule) {
      actual_value <- switch(
        rule$metric,
        "total_users" = run_row$total_users,
        "error_rate"  = run_row$error_rate,
        "throughput"  = run_row$throughput,
        NA
      )

      passed <- if (!is.na(actual_value)) {
        evaluate_sla_rule(actual_value, rule$operator, rule$threshold)
      } else {
        NA
      }

      list(
        metric    = rule$metric,
        label     = rule$label,
        operator  = rule$operator,
        threshold = rule$threshold,
        unit      = if (is.null(rule$unit)) "" else rule$unit,
        actual    = actual_value,
        passed    = passed
      )
    })

    overall_pass <- all(sapply(rule_outcomes, function(x) isTRUE(x$passed)))

    sla_results[[as.character(rid)]] <- list(
      run_id       = rid,
      rules        = rule_outcomes,
      overall_pass = overall_pass
    )
  }

  message(">>> [SLA] Evaluated SLA for ", length(sla_results), " run(s) using ", basename(sla_file_path))

} else {
  message(">>> [SLA] No sla_file defined or file not found — skipping SLA processing.")
}

# ============================================================
# RESPONSE TIME SLA EVALUATION — per-transaction, per-run
# ============================================================
rt_sla_results <- list()  # named list keyed by run_id

if (!is.null(sla_file_path) && nzchar(trimws(sla_file_path)) && file.exists(here::here(sla_file_path))) {

  rt_sla_config <- sla_config$response_time_sla

  if (!is.null(rt_sla_config)) {

    rt_metric        <- rt_sla_config$metric           # "p90" or "p95"
    rt_percentile    <- if (rt_metric == "p90") 0.90 else 0.95
    rt_default       <- rt_sla_config$default_threshold
    rt_tolerance_pct <- if (is.null(rt_sla_config$tolerance_pct)) 0 else rt_sla_config$tolerance_pct

    # Build a lookup: label -> threshold (overrides take priority, else default)
    rt_overrides <- rt_sla_config$overrides
    rt_threshold_lookup <- if (!is.null(rt_overrides) && length(rt_overrides) > 0) {
      setNames(
        sapply(rt_overrides, function(x) x$threshold),
        sapply(rt_overrides, function(x) x$label)
      )
    } else {
      c()
    }

    # get_rt_threshold <- function(label) {
    #   if (label %in% names(rt_threshold_lookup)) {
    #     unname(rt_threshold_lookup[label])
    #   } else {
    #     rt_default
    #   }
    # }
    get_rt_threshold <- function(label) {

      matching_prefixes <- names(rt_threshold_lookup)[
        startsWith(label, names(rt_threshold_lookup))
      ]

      if (length(matching_prefixes) > 0) {

        # Use longest match first
        matching_prefixes <- matching_prefixes[
          order(nchar(matching_prefixes), decreasing = TRUE)
        ]

        return(
          unname(
            rt_threshold_lookup[
              matching_prefixes[1]
            ]
          )
        )
      }

      rt_default
    }

    # ── Compute percentile RT per run_id per label ──
    rt_per_label <- raw_data %>%
      group_by(run_id, label) %>%
      summarise(
        actual_rt = round(quantile(elapsed, rt_percentile, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
        .groups   = "drop"
      ) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        threshold      = get_rt_threshold(label),
        tolerance_band = threshold * (1 + rt_tolerance_pct / 100),
        passed         = actual_rt <= tolerance_band,
        breach_pct     = round(((actual_rt - threshold) / threshold) * 100, 1)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()

    # ── Summarise per run_id ──
    for (rid in unique(rt_per_label$run_id)) {
      run_labels <- rt_per_label %>% filter(run_id == rid)

      total_labels  <- nrow(run_labels)
      failed_labels <- run_labels %>% filter(!passed)
      failed_count  <- nrow(failed_labels)

      top_breaches <- failed_labels %>%
        arrange(desc(breach_pct)) %>%
        slice_head(n = 10) %>%
        select(label, actual_rt, threshold, breach_pct)

      rt_sla_results[[as.character(rid)]] <- list(
        run_id        = rid,
        metric        = rt_metric,
        total_labels  = total_labels,
        failed_count  = failed_count,
        passed_count  = total_labels - failed_count,
        top_breaches  = top_breaches,
        all_labels    = run_labels
      )
    }

    message(">>> [SLA] Response Time SLA (", toupper(rt_metric), ") evaluated for ", length(rt_sla_results), " run(s).")

  }
}

# ── Helper to get SLA threshold for a metric ──
get_sla_threshold <- function(run_id, metric_name) {
  key <- as.character(run_id)
  if (length(sla_results) == 0 || is.null(sla_results[[key]])) return(NULL)
  rule <- Filter(function(r) r$metric == metric_name, sla_results[[key]]$rules)
  if (length(rule) == 0) return(NULL)
  list(
    threshold = rule[[1]]$threshold,
    operator  = rule[[1]]$operator,
    unit      = rule[[1]]$unit %||% ""
  )
}

# Helper to safely get RT SLA result for a run
get_run_rt_sla <- function(run_id) {
  key <- as.character(run_id)
  if (length(rt_sla_results) == 0 || is.null(rt_sla_results[[key]])) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  rt_sla_results[[key]]
}

get_app_tps_threshold <- function(app_name) {

  throughput_rule <- Filter(
    function(x) x$metric == "throughput",
    sla_config$sla_rules
  )[[1]]

  overrides <- throughput_rule$application_thresholds

  app_rule <- Filter(
    function(x) identical(x$app_name, app_name),
    overrides
  )

  if (length(app_rule) > 0) {
    return(as.numeric(app_rule[[1]]$threshold))
  }

  throughput_rule$threshold
}

get_app_error_threshold <- function(app_name) {

  error_rule <- Filter(
    function(x) x$metric == "error_rate",
    sla_config$sla_rules
  )[[1]]

  overrides <- error_rule$application_thresholds

  app_rule <- Filter(
    function(x) identical(x$app_name, app_name),
    overrides
  )

  if (length(app_rule) > 0) {
    return(as.numeric(app_rule[[1]]$threshold))
  }

  as.numeric(error_rule$threshold)
}

# ============================================================
# CHART VISIBILITY — controlled via config.yaml "charts:" block
# Defaults to TRUE (shown) if config missing or key not defined
# ============================================================
chart_visibility <- params_cfg$charts

is_chart_enabled <- function(chart_key) {
  if (is.null(chart_visibility) || is.null(chart_visibility[[chart_key]])) {
    return(TRUE)  # default: show if not explicitly configured
  }
  isTRUE(chart_visibility[[chart_key]]) || identical(tolower(as.character(chart_visibility[[chart_key]])), "true")
}
```
